notes.title: Supermarket Billionaire is officially out today!
notes.content: [h1] Supermarket Billionaire is officially out today! ːsteamthumbsupː[/h1][p]After months of hard work, we’re excited to finally share Supermarket Billionaire with you our brand new idle game where you build and grow your own supermarket empire![/p][p]Buy and upgrade products, hire employees, improve your facilities, and optimize every part of your business to become the next big billionaire![/p][p]We want to give a huge thank you to everyone who supported us during development your encouragement, feedback, and patience mean the world. [/p][p]This is just the beginning: we have many exciting updates and features planned, and we can’t wait to shape this game together with the community.[/p][p]Let us know what you think, and thank you again for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p]
